comments: |
    Published in "Probing of RNA structures in a positive sense RNA virus reveals selection pressures for structural elements", Watters et al., Nucleic Acids Research, 2018
    Publication doi: 10.1093/nar/gkx1273
    Modification was performed directly in plant cell lysates, using primers specific for RNA3 of CMV
    REACTIVITY and READS are stored below in groups for each replicate. Reactivity is first, then modified reads, followed by unmodified reads
    Multiple priming sites exist and are listed in order from furthest priming site from the 5' end to closest, 8 priming sites in total (8 for each replicate)
    Reactivities are reported as rhos (normalized beta values), calculated using the stratified method described in the associated publication
    Post spats.py processing of the overlapping reactivity windows can be done with "overlapping_reactivities.py", as part of Spats or a similar implementation in SEQualyzer, which includes automatically generated plots
    rho_i = beta_i * L, where L = length of RNA sequence with data (2191 nt)
    See Aviran, S., Lucks, J.B., and Pachter, L. (doi:10.1109/Allerton.2011.6120379) for theta_i and beta_i reactivity definitions
    field STRUCTURE was determined using ShapesKnots, m = 1.1, b = -0.3
    Errors provided are standard deviations at each nucleotide, calculated from DATA with datatype:REACTIVITY in the sets below
